title: My Help Comes
series: Songs for the Journey: Psalms of Ascent
description: Why does an old story still speak so clearly to us today?
This week we open Psalm 121 and ask what the passage is really saying, before we ask what it means for us.
We notice how the passage fits into the larger story of Songs for the Journey, and what has come just before it.
Along the way we meet some familiar excuses, and some better reasons to hope.
